properties.label: Dial with four stop conditions
properties.text: Balance a large ivory rotary instrument on a fine dot grid with a concise list of four selectable conditions; open one useful explanation for the active row.

properties.label: Quiet instrument labels
properties.text: Keep labels and descriptions quieter than the physical object while retaining clear active, focus and long-description states.

properties.label: Ivory, graphite and orange marks
properties.text: Use warm ivory, graphite and tiny orange marks to carry the active instrument state.

properties.label: Bevelled detent dial
properties.text: Build a softly recessed circular face from concentric bevel rings, radial ticks, a short raised pointer and a grounded shadow.

properties.label: Settling detent pointer
properties.text: Turn the pointer to the selected detent with a restrained settling transition; reduced motion changes to the composed result immediately.

properties.label: User-stopped scripted cycling
properties.text: Make all four rows real buttons that update pointer and description together, and stop scripted cycling as soon as the user selects anything.

properties.label: Four-detent control acceptance
properties.text: Check every detent, focus state and pointer alignment; fit long descriptions without clipping and stop timers while the tab is hidden.
